title: Bolder hand: choose the new look for brickbot.ro
question: Foreign forms at full commitment, as you asked. Each card keeps the wordmark, the motto, a student photo, the Support CTA and the top-10 praise. The sketches are now first screens at full detail: open a card's expand chip to see one at full size. One dealt card, a curved paper-fold shell, is left out because you turned it down in an earlier round.

options.label: Night Grid
options.lineage: a sleeping city whose streets fold like blankets and whose windows glow like stitched stars
options.thesis: Focșani at night as a folded black map: window lights glow yellow, a bolt strikes from the sky, and the students' photo is a district folded up out of the map.
options.viewport: Wordmark across the night sky, the motto and Support button on the left, the Nationals photo as a curved, folded patch on the right, and a burgundy pin reading “Focșani → Houston · Top 10 in the world”.
options.risk: The most conceptual card in the hand, the kind you ruled out before; the map carries mood more than facts.

raised.raise: Exactly one burst flash at a time, on whatever is active, so energy has one place to land.

options.label: Signal Field
options.lineage: data-sublime installations: barcode bar fields, sine lattices, full-frame strobe inversions
options.thesis: BrickBot as a live electrical signal: yellow barcode fields and a sine trace on pure black, with the season's real results set as data, and the whole screen flashes inverted for one frame like a lightning strike.
options.viewport: A barcode strip under the nav, the giant wordmark, the motto, then a ruled data row (Top 10 · World 2026 / Division finalist · FIRST Championship / #15996 · since 2016), with a strobing student photo sliced into bars on the right.
options.case: Wins on both axes: reads as serious engineering to a sponsor, and the real results become the hero's structure. Lightning is the motion itself.
options.risk: Can feel cold or techy if the student photo gets too abstracted; the flash must be rare and respect reduced motion.

options.label: Departures Board
options.lineage: rail and airport split-flap departure boards
options.thesis: The team's season as a departures board: the motto clacks in on flaps, past events show as arrived, and next season is boarding, with Support as the gate.
options.viewport: Wordmark top left, the motto on yellow-and-white flaps beneath it, the Nationals photo top right with a “Top 10 in the world · 2026” tag, and the board below: 26–27 BioBuzz boarding → Support; Houston, Bucharest and the world ranking arrived.
options.case: Wins on both axes: everyone can read a departures board, and it maps exactly onto a team that travels to competitions; the next season boarding makes Support the obvious action.
options.risk: Lightning is weaker here: the electricity lives in the lamps and the cascade, not in bolts.

options.label: Teletext P100
options.lineage: broadcast teletext pages: block mosaics, double-height type, page numbers, coloured Fastext keys
options.thesis: BrickBot as a teletext service: a giant lightning bolt built from mosaic blocks, double-height headings, and Fastext keys along the bottom as the main actions.
options.viewport: A P100 header row and a burgundy band, the wordmark, a block-mosaic bolt, the Worlds team photo with pixel-stepped corners, the motto in double-height type, and four Fastext keys: Support us, Our season, Work with us, Contact.
options.case: Holds audience: anyone over 30 remembers TVR teletext, and the block bolt is pure electricity. Loses on clarity: page numbers and the retro grid make strangers work harder.
options.risk: Retro novelty: it can feel like a joke page if the grid isn't strict.

options.label: Toy Catalogue
options.thesis: Products packed edge to edge with burst price flashes.
options.case: Reads as a toy brand to national sponsors, and the no-margin packing hurts first-time readers.
options.kept: One burst flash, only on what's active.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark team site played straight: full-bleed photo, headline, two buttons, a stats row, then cards.
canonCard.viewport: Photo hero with the wordmark, the motto, two buttons and a stats row underneath.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other team site, by design.
